materials.hardware: plain dark iron straps, bolts and hooks without ornate metalwork
materials.primary_frame: reclaimed pallet timber and repaired drawer-board supports with visible joinery
materials.storage: one small side crate and a short rack for large offcuts or rods
materials.tool_board: one faded blue or cream salvaged appliance slab with a few large readable hand tools
materials.weather_cover: one shallow irregular galvanized sheet canopy with a small canvas patch, visibly supported by timber
materials.work_surface: broad worn timber bench top with a dark metal hand vise, no powered machinery

prohibited_changes: do not change RoomDefinition landmarks, dimensions, work-site identity or assignments
do not add render meshes to collision, navigation, selection or work-site calculations
do not add canonical-room-specific placement or simulation logic
do not use Clockwork gears, powered machinery, decorative brass or copper trim
required_features: workbench, large tool board and open work entrance remain readable at the 64-inch gameplay camera
open bay and hand-work function are distinct from the Scavenger Depot and paired homes
broad reclaimed timber, faded enamel, sheet metal and restrained canvas establish Scavenger identity
roof, bench and tool board have visible supports and plausible load paths
fit the existing 23 x 9 x 12 inch presentation envelope
semantic_type: open shared Scavenger work bay with salvaged bench, tool wall and staged parts
stylization_rationale: RoomScale is a miniature diorama. Stylization is allowed when the work bay remains believable as a built, hand-operated salvage workshop and its work function reads at gameplay scale.
visual_target: Create a compact, visibly open Scavenger work bay within the existing 23 x 9 x 12 inch presentation envelope. At the 64-inch Room A camera, make the shared hand-work bench, one broad wall-mounted tool board, and the clear open work entrance read before small tools. Build the work area from repaired pallet timber, reused drawer boards, a faded blue or cream appliance panel, mismatched galvanized rain sheets and one restrained canvas patch. Give it a lean improvised silhouette distinct from a depot loading shed and paired housing. Show believable supports, a plain hand vise, a small parts crate and several clearly separated large tool shapes. Preserve the current landmark and all simulation-owned work-site behavior.
